items.headline: Best-Positioned Stocks as EV and Self-Driving Tech Accelerate
items.snippet: Albemarle appears well-positioned as EV demand grows, projecting 10-20% lithium demand CAGR from 2025 to 2030.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized a tight lithium market due to strong EV and stationary storage demand, with supply lagging. 2026 outlook maintained, expecting the high end of scenario ranges.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock; Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), upside appears limited.

items.headline: The demand for lithium carbonate is expected to continue its growth trend, with potential for price increases.
items.snippet: Albemarle's Chile capacity has been affected by strikes; SQM expects lithium sales growth in 2H. Fenix Phase II and Sal de Vida are starting ahead of schedule.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: Chinese EV sales fell 13% in 1H26 after subsidy withdrawals, yet global lithium consumption jumped 45% through May, above Albemarle's 15-40% forecast range.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia have seen profits soar as demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher. Albemarle (ALB) noted that global lithium demand grew 45% through May this year, significantly outstripping supply.
